title: Pairs without a reward model
summary: Which alignment method trains on pairs with only a reference policy.

choices.text: Rejection-sampling fine-tuning. It ranks fresh samples with the chosen-versus-rejected labels and fine-tunes on the winners, with the frozen copy as a KL reference.
PPO-based RLHF. The pairs train a reward model first, but because you keep a frozen copy, PPO needs no critic and runs offline on the pairs alone.
DPO. It turns the KL-constrained preference objective into a classification loss on the pairs, with the frozen policy as the reference.
Best-of-n reranking at inference. It updates the weights from the pairs without a training loss.
